method.frameSubmission: performance.now around render(time); includes geometry reads and command submission, not GPU completion
method.frameCadence: requestAnimationFrame timestamp intervals during active scene; preview/display/recording can constrain cadence
method.gpuTiming: optional asynchronous EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2 nanoseconds converted to ms; disjoint samples rejected, polling outside submission timing
method.serializedCompletion: separate render(time)+gl.finish wall time after prior GPU drain; benchmark-only synchronization; includes JS, IPC, driver and GPU, not pure GPU time or FPS
method.resourceCounters: separate instrumented steady-frame pass, not included in timings
method.workload: 640x400 CSS pixels by default, maxDpr1, same eight lenses/palette/optics for baseline/current. Fields are current-only decorative instances; not thousands of DOM widgets.
method.shaderQuality: No lowered DPR or wallpaper resolution for before/after. New texture interpolation is assessed separately by fixed-time RGB comparison.
